pages.title: Ion Game
pages.text: The Ion Game is a whack-a-mole game. 13 rounds of disabling the lights across the room. The higher the round, the more lights are lit.

pages.title: Ion Cell
pages.text: An Ion Cell is used to start the game at the Ion Converter block. Talk to the NPC to start the process.

pages.title: Rewired Ion Cell
pages.text: A Rewired Ion Cell is given for succesfully completing the game.
